scope: Clean MOSI/MOSEI evaluation of all 78 selected checkpoints; five-seed main, three-seed module and modality ablations
selection: Minimum sample-weighted dev MAE within the fixed epoch budget; earliest exact tie. No retraining on train+dev, test-based checkpoint selection or threshold tuning.
primary_metric: MAE, computed on unclipped regression output

secondary_metrics.corr: Pearson r; null if prediction or label variance is zero
secondary_metrics.acc7: Compare numpy.round(clip(x,-3,3)) for both prediction and label; round half to even
secondary_metrics.f1: True-support weighted binary F1 under acc2 convention
secondary_metrics.f1_non_zero: True-support weighted binary F1 under nonzero convention
secondary_metrics.confusion: Rows true, columns predicted; negative then nonnegative for all, negative then positive for nonzero; counts retained

storage: Per-sample ids, labels, regression predictions; checkpoint/config hash, selected epoch, full scalar metrics and both confusion matrices. Metrics stored as fractions; presentation percentages explicitly labeled.
reporting: Per-seed results, mean and sample SD (ddof=1). Main table five downstream seeds when complete; ablations three. Fixed pretraining checkpoint; seed variability describes downstream training only. Preserve provenance that first three seeds were used in development; report new two-seed paired differences separately as well.

significance.primary_test: Two-sided paired t test and 95% t interval after all five planned seeds finish
significance.multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment across four primary tests: two pairs x two datasets
significance.sensitivity: Exact two-sided sign-flip test over paired seed differences; with five seeds minimum two-sided p is 0.0625, report resolution without replacing it with instance resampling
significance.cdml: Requires comparable per-seed or per-instance outputs; published aggregate scores alone cannot support a paired test

reuse: 78 unique checkpoints: 30 main, 24 module, 42 modality table rows; shared checkpoints evaluated once.
remaining: Clean test evaluation and paired statistics
Synchronized progressive corruption of main and correlation inputs, score response and routing statistics
Parameter counts, compute/memory/latency plus cache generation/storage costs
Original-GLoMo reproduction protocol comparison and baseline-gap explanation
Multimodal success/failure cases with verified original media
External baseline literature and any additional-language feasibility decision
exclusions: MOSI nontext fit diagnostics are analysis only, not substituted for frozen ablations. Modality ablation does not replace gradual-corruption robustness evaluation.
